verification.notes: Utah Rule of Evidence 1102 allows reliable hearsay at a preliminary examination and recognizes categories that are also trial-admissible. The hearing also included substantial live and forensic testimony. Some preliminary-hearing hearsay may be unavailable at trial, but the blanket characterization that the entire or overwhelming majority was hearsay and inadmissible is not supported.

appearances.snippet: And we know that that took place, that preliminary hearing across five days in early July. And I made it very clear to you guys that under the Utah 1102 rule, ... Reliable hearsay is permitted at that stage. Hearsay meaning, as just one example, that's perfectly acceptable under Utah's constitution for Lance Twiggs to submit a video testimony. ... The prosecution, sorry, the defense is not able to cross-examine him, which seems so wild to us, but this is, it's probative that Lance (Lance Twiggs)'s lawyer is able to lead him in ... Questioning normally there would be all of these objections from the defense because you aren't allowed to ask leading questions but for the sake of this probative hearing everything pretty much flies right people do not have to appear in person it's enough you sort of just trust the science when Officer Bagley (Chris Bagley) gets up there or Officer Hull (David Hull) gets up there and says he was told by someone that this happened that Tyler Robinson's vehicle pulled the side of the road and he remembered the ... Plates and you're like well where is that officer that shouldn't we hear from him no he doesn't you don't have to hear from him at this stage it's not needed it is constitutional and it's just when you get to the trial that none of that will be accepted now the judge in this case is the magistrate he ultimately calls balls and strikes and to be clear it just seems that there are virtually no balls and strikes at this stage everything is evidence.
